ValueOne is recruiting a Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport for Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS. In this newly established role, you will be responsible for driving and developing the Group's strategic procurement activities within the logistics and transportation category. The position is physically based at the Danish subsidiary's office south of Copenhagen and reports to Head of Supply Chain Operations & Development. We welcome applications from candidates residing in both Sweden and Denmark.

About Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS

Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS is one of the Nordic region's leading distributors and brand partners within food, beverages, snacks, and confectionery. With more than 100 years of experience, the Group helps both international and proprietary brands grow across the Nordic markets through strong capabilities in marketing, sales, logistics, and category development. Supply Chain is regarded as a key competitive advantage, with a strong focus on customer and brand value while ensuring the right balance between service and cost. The company currently generates annual revenues of MNOK 4500 and employs approximately 400 people across the Nordic countries. Following an acquisition in 2026, Haugen-Gruppen has also established a presence in Poland and intends to continue expanding beyond the Nordic region.

About the Role

The Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport is part of the Nordic Supply Chain team and responsible for strategic sourcing and category management at Group level within transportation, third-party logistics (3PL), warehouse equipment, packaging materials and load carriers, and, where relevant, selected third-party manufacturing. The role works closely with stakeholders across the various markets to develop competitive and sustainable supplier solutions that strengthen Haugen-Gruppen's supply chain while ensuring the right service levels and total cost position.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and develop the Group-wide Logistics & Transport category strategy.

• Lead strategic sourcing and procurement initiatives across transportation, 3PL, warehousing, and related logistics services.

• Drive the Source-to-Contract process, including sourcing strategy, tendering, negotiations, contracting, and implementation.

• Develop and optimize Route-to-Market solutions in collaboration with Supply Chain and Commercial stakeholders.

• Manage supplier relationships, commercial agreements, and performance to ensure competitiveness, service excellence, and sustainability.

• Identify cost optimization opportunities through spend analysis, market intelligence, and supplier development.

• Mitigate supplier risk and ensure compliance with Group policies, standards, and sustainability requirements.

• Support strategic sourcing initiatives across adjacent supply chain categories when required.

Experience and Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• A Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field, alternatively equivalent relevant experience.

• Proven experience in strategic sourcing and category management managing suppliers and commercial agreements within indirect material and services.

• Strong commercial and analytical capabilities within spend analysis, tendering, negotiation, and total cost of ownership (TCO) assessment.

• Knowledge of sustainability requirements and compliance standards within logistics and procurement.

• Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

• Experience within logistics, transportation, supply chain, or FMCG environments is considered highly advantageous.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for a proactive, accountable, analytical, and solution-oriented professional who enjoys working in an international environment. You have excellent communication and organizational skills and thrive when collaborating across functions, countries, and cultures.

A service-minded, flexible approach combined with a continuous improvement mindset will be essential for success in this role.

Application

We welcome your application for the position of Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For further information, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist James Li at James.Li@valueone.se.

About ValueOne

ValueOne specializes in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, and Logistics. We support our clients through three business areas:

• Interim Procurement and Supply Chain Consultants

• Recruitment of Procurement and Logistics Professionals

• Management Consulting

Through our consulting services, we help organizations develop and improve their procurement, logistics, and supply chain capabilities covering strategy, operating models, processes, organization, governance, and competence development.

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. Are you an experienced OT SCADA professional who wants to help secure the reliable operation of business-critical systems? Would you like to apply your technical expertise in an operational technology environment supporting the future of renewable energy?

As our new OT SCADA Engineer (Integration & Operations), you will be responsible for engineering, integrating, maintaining, operating, and continuously improving SCADA systems, ensuring data flows between power plants, market-facing control applications used by BA Markets, the Operational Control Centre’s monitoring and control systems, and other data consumers underpinning Vattenfall’s business-critical renewable-energy Operational Technology applications.

You will participate in the team’s on-call rotation to support business-critical services that operate around the clock. You will help restore service during incidents and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

A key part of your role will be applying structured engineering, security and lifecycle-management principles to keep the platforms reliable, supportable and compliant with Vattenfall standards and operational requirements. You will work closely with internal colleagues, external stakeholders and suppliers.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Your role

As an OT SCADA Engineer, you will take ownership of SCADA systems and related data flows throughout their lifecycle, from initial analysis and engineering through implementation, operation, improvement and eventual replacement or decommissioning.

You will combine hands-on technical work with structured planning, documentation, and collaboration. Your focus will be on maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable SCADA systems and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen performance, availability, and operational resilience.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Engineering, configuring, commissioning, maintaining, and improving OT SCADA solutions and interfaces for assets in operation and development.

• 
Delivering and supporting reliable data flows from plant-level systems through approved OT integration layers to monitoring, control, analytics, reporting, and data-platform consumers.

• 
Assessing site and interface readiness, identifying integration prerequisites, technical constraints, dependencies, risks and ownership boundaries, and defining requirements and integration approaches.

• 
Configuring, deploying, and supporting resilient SCADA integration components, including industrial edge devices or gateways, connectors, and data pipelines, with appropriate monitoring, troubleshooting, deployment documentation, and operational handover.

• 
Planning, estimating, and tracking assigned work, making dependencies, risks, and progress visible, and documenting and maintaining technical records and operational knowledge.

• 
Providing operational support, including incident diagnosis, service restoration, root-cause and problem analysis, defining and implementing preventive and proactive improvement actions.

• 
Participating in the team's on-call rotation, providing specialist OT SCADA support for business-critical services outside normal working hours.

• 
Improving observability and data quality through health monitoring, completeness checks, alerting, backfilling support, performance analysis, and clear operational ownership.

• 
Planning and executing lifecycle upgrades, migrations, patches, configuration changes, and component replacements using approved change and DTAP practices.

• 
Producing requirements, designs, implementation guides, configuration records, test cases, support documentation, and operational handover packages including operational runbooks, support responsibilities and escalation arrangements

• 
Supporting technical purchasing and supplier coordination through technical evaluations, solution validation, and design reviews.

• 
Preparing and executing tests and commissioning checks for assigned solutions, recording test evidence, tracking defects to resolution, and supporting factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), acceptance decisions, and operational-readiness assessments.

• 
Standardizing repeatable integration services and work packages for asset projects, while supporting refinement and estimation of less standardized initiatives.

• 
Supporting internal and external audit activities.

Your profile

You hold a relevant bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, automation or control engineering, computer engineering, technical computer science, industrial IT, or a related discipline. Alternatively, you have developed equivalent professional competence through a relevant technical qualification and substantial experience in OT SCADA engineering.

You have several years of hands-on experience engineering, integrating, and supporting SCADA systems or comparable industrial OT solutions, including responsibility for systems in operation. You thrive when taking ownership of solutions from analysis and design through to implementation, operation, and continuous improvement. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating with colleagues, suppliers, and stakeholders across the organisation. To succeed in this role, you must have excellent written and spoken English skills. The role may also be subject to security clearance, and candidates must be able to meet the applicable screening requirements.

You bring knowledge and experience in:

• SCADA systems and interfaces: configuring, integrating, commissioning, managing, maintaining, operating, and supporting SCADA applications, gateways, and interfaces connecting operational assets with central systems and data consumers.

• Industrial communications: working with relevant industrial protocols such as OPC UA, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP or MQTT, as well as APIs and vendor-specific interfaces where applicable, and diagnosing communication and integration issues.

• Operational resilience: practical understanding of high availability, service monitoring and logging, SCADA application and configuration backup and recovery, and configuration management, including dependencies on hosting and network services.

• Operational data flows: understanding signal mapping, timestamps, data quality, buffering, and the recovery of missing historical data.

• Incident and problem management: diagnosing faults across SCADA applications, interfaces, source and target systems, including dependencies on server services, networks, certificates and service accounts; restoring services; investigating root causes; and implementing preventive and proactive improvements.

• Controlled technical changes: planning and delivering upgrades, migrations and configuration changes with appropriate testing, deployment documentation, rollback arrangements and operational handover.

• Secure OT operation: applying OT security requirements, including access controls, certificate handling, system hardening and vulnerability management, within approved architectures and change procedures and in collaboration with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

• Engineering documentation: producing and maintaining clear technical documentation of SCADA system architectures, configurations and procedures.

• Supplier collaboration: supporting technical purchasing, assessing and validating solutions, supporting acceptance testing and coordinating technical work with colleagues and external suppliers.

Additional experience that would be valuable:

• Renewable energy, utilities or comparable industrial environments.

• OEM SCADA interfaces.

• Industrial edge platforms or gateways.

• SCADA historians, SQL databases, scripting and automation.

Personal traits

To succeed in this role, we believe that you:

• Bring strong analytical skills, approach technical challenges with proactive, structured problem-solving, and remain composed when resolving operational incidents.

• Communicate clearly and can connect technical, operational and supplier-related perspectives.

• Are comfortable taking end-to-end responsibility, from analysis and planning through implementation and delivery.

• Work independently while contributing actively and collaborating effectively across disciplines with internal and external stakeholders.

• Are organised, reliable and committed to high-quality documentation.

• Take a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

• Use sound judgment to balance immediate service restoration, long-term reliability, maintainability and agreed delivery priorities.

• Are willing to participate in the team’s on-call rotation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Kolding

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact hiring manager Steffen Hellmich, steffen.hellmich@vattenfall.de. For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 22-11-2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. As a Manager, you will bring your experience to a collaborative team, take a leading role in client engagements and contribute to developing our people and practice.

You will lead a broad range of projects for clients across sectors. • Build client relationships and deliver practical advice with colleagues across Deloitte’s international network.

• Develop less experienced colleagues through feedback, work review and knowledge sharing.

• Help grow our practice by spotting new opportunities and shaping solutions for existing and new clients.

jobs.occupation: Take the next step in your Transfer Pricing career
jobs.description:
With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. As a Manager, you will bring your experience to a collaborative team, take a leading role in client engagements and contribute to developing our people and practice.

You will lead a broad range of projects for clients across sectors. Working with colleagues across Deloitte, you will turn complex analyses into practical advice and take responsibility for engagements from planning through to delivery. You will also help develop less experienced colleagues and continue building your own technical and leadership skills through training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will:

• Manage transfer pricing engagements across advisory, compliance and disputes, overseeing teams, timelines and quality.

• Build client relationships and deliver practical advice with colleagues across Deloitte’s international network.

• Develop less experienced colleagues through feedback, work review and knowledge sharing.

• Help grow our practice by spotting new opportunities and shaping solutions for existing and new clients.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will help identify where they can add value to research, analysis and delivery, while applying sound judgement and maintaining responsibility for the quality of the work. No specialist AI expertise is required, but curiosity and a willingness to improve how we work matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones.

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

We are looking for experienced transfer pricing professionals who are ready to take responsibility for client engagements and contribute to the development of our team. You may already be working as a Manager ready for the next step.

You combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of client needs. You take ownership, collaborate openly and are comfortable coordinating the work of others while remaining hands-on with analysis and delivery.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• Solid experience in transfer pricing, gained in an advisory firm, an in-house role or a comparable environment (minimum 5 years).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex technical and financial information into clear recommendations.

• Curiosity about technology and judgement when using AI-enabled tools.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and confidence discussing technical matters with clients and colleagues.

• An interest in developing others through guidance, feedback and knowledge sharing.

• A strong client-service mindset and an interest in building relationships and contributing to new opportunities.

• Work permit in Denmark

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV, grade transcript and an application outlining your motivation for joining our Transfer Pricing team and highlighting relevant experience by 4 December 2026. We regularly call for interviews, so send your application already today.

Please do not hesitate to contact Partner Cecilie Emilie Rendtorff at crendtorff@deloitte.dk or Aske Haahr Lauridsen at aslauridsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

About Puzzel 🔍

We're the AI-native customer experience platform built in Norway, trusted across Europe, and growing fast. For 25 years we've helped contact centres deliver faster, more human service — without the clutter or complexity. Today we're #1 in the Nordics, scaling rapidly in the UK and the Netherlands, with one ambition: become Europe's clear CX market leader.

Puzzel Values 🎯

• 
Built on Trust - our Nordic foundation. Customers, partners, and each other.

• 
Stronger Together - one team, one purpose, shared wins.

• 
Stay Hungry - we raise our game every day.

Why we’re proud_🏆_

• 
Frost Radar Innovation & Growth Leader in EMEA Customer Experience Platforms (2025)

• 
CX Awards 'Best Mid-Market Contact Center Platform' (2024)

• 
Flexa Top 10 most inclusive companies and Top 25 for work-life balance, diversity and inclusion, pet-friendly companies and professional services (2026)

• 
Consistently high Glassdoor rating

• 
Mercer-benchmarked pay for equity and market fairness

• 
Puzzel doesn't just build AI for our customers — we’ve embraced it internally, adopting it across the business to work smarter and faster

Read more about us here.

What you'll do 🏡💻

This is a 100% net-new business role. You’ll drive your own prospecting, while working closely with our SDR, our partners and our marketing team to create and convert opportunities. Our SDR focuses on our top 100 accounts every day, marketing supports you with lead generation and events, and partners are an important source of new ARR in Denmark.

You’re proactive, solution-oriented and not afraid to shake things up. You communicate excellently, manage your own time and processes well, and know how to close deals.

You should have good time management skills, be comfortable running your own processes and excel at the following:

• 
Building and nurturing relationships with customers and partners or creating business opportunities from scratch - it's important to highlight that you'll be managing the full sales cycle from initial prospecting to close.

• 
Generate your own pipeline through outbound activity, spending a meaningful part of each week on direct and partner-led prospecting

• 
Collaborate with the SDR and marketing to turn target accounts, leads and events into qualified opportunities

• 
Recruit, enable and co-sell with partners and channel organisations to generate and close pipeline

• 
Run discovery calls, demos and presentations, building a thorough understanding of each customer’s needs, business and processes

• 
Take performance and budget responsibility for your own portfolio, driving growth and profitability

• 
Use our systems and automated sequences (Salesforce and Outreach in particular) to minimise manual work and follow RevOps best practice

The must haves 💪

• 
Danish native level speaker + strong English

• 
Technological understanding and interest in the field of cloud-based services

• 
At least 3 years’ experience managing full sales cycle, from prospect to close

• 
Proven outbound experience, and a track record of generating your own pipeline (ideally you still do your own outreach today)

• 
CX or complex B2B SaaS sales experience

• 
Experience working with structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC and/or Challenger preferable) & sales pipelining

• 
Proactive, entrepreneurial mentality and willingness to self-generate pipeline are a must

• 
Autonomy and confidence to sell into a growing market

• 
The nice to haves ➕➕➕

• 
Experience of selling through partners or channels

• 
Exposure to an international environment

• 
Additional language skills

• 
CCaaS / competitor industry experience

The location

This role is based in our Aarhus or Copenhagen offices, with a hybrid set up of 2-3 days per week in the office.

What to expect from the interview process ❔

• 
Screening call with Talent Acquisition

• 
1st interview with the Sales Director & local Account Executive

• 
Final panel presentation

Diversity & Inclusion 🌍

We want everyone at Puzzel to feel able to be their true, authentic self at work – regardless of nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical ability, age or economic background.

We're proud of our diverse, global workforce, but there's more to do. Our current gender split is 25% female to 75% male – in line with the SaaS average, but not where we want to be. Here's how we're improving it:

• 
Our C-suite has moved from 100% male in 2023 to a 5:3 male-to-female split today.

• 
Female hires grew from 23.6% in 2021 to 41% in 2024, dipping to 34% in 2025 — a trend we watch closely, but never treating as a tick-box exercise.

• 
We partner with Flexa, to compound our aspiration to attract a diverse talent pool.

• 
We work with state employment initiatives in Norway and Sweden on internship and apprenticeship routes, to help early-years talent into the workforce.

One Last Thing ☝🏻

Even if you're only a 75% match for this role, we still want to hear from you — this list is indicative, and skills can always be learnt.

We're unable to offer sponsorship for this role, so you'll need existing eligibility to work in the country you're applying to.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning is responsible for coordinating end-to-end supply planning and execution for assigned products across Genmab’s global commercial supply chains, ensuring reliable and compliant product supply to markets.

Working closely with CMOs and internal cross-functional stakeholders, the Manager maintains up-to-date supply plans and coordinates operational planning and execution processes. The role ensures transparency of batch status, supply priorities, responsibilities, and risks, with timely follow-up and escalation to support supply continuity in a global, GxP-regulated environment. The role also collaborates with Clinical Supply to support alignment across commercial and clinical supply needs.

You will be joining the Corporate Supply Chain Planning team, reporting to the Senior Director. The team is responsible for Genmab’s global supply chain planning activities and supports Genmab’s mission to transform patient lives through innovative antibody medicines.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning you will be responsible for planning and executing supply chain activities across commercial programs, for an assigned product/product group or supply chain, ensuring alignment between demand, manufacturing, and distribution.

• Oversee daily supply chain operations, including order management, replenishment, inventory planning, and supply planning across international markets

• Coordinate operational planning and execution processes across Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Life Cycle Management, Logistics, and CMOs for assigned products, ensuring supply plans remain up to date and that batch status, priorities, responsibilities, and risks are transparent across functions

• Facilitate daily operational meetings to coordinate activities, track agreed actions, and escalate issues impacting supply through established governance

• Act as key interface with CMOs to align on production schedules, execution, and supply priorities

• Serve as key user of ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), supporting planning, execution, and data integrity

• Ensure GxP compliance across the supply chain in collaboration with Quality Assurance, including deviation handling, root cause analysis, and CAPA implementation

• Identify, assess, and mitigate supply and capacity risks, developing contingency plans that strengthen business resilience and protect patient supply

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities through proper documentation and process adherence

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, new product introductions, CMC project activities, and process standardization efforts that improve planning maturity, execution reliability, and scalability

• Contribute to the S&OP process for assigned products through supply planning inputs, risk assessments, and scenario evaluations

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field

• +6 years of experience in supply chain planning, logistics, or a related function

• Experience within biotech, pharmaceutical, or other GxP-regulated industries is preferred

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA) and supply planning tools

• Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and forecasting (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar tools)

• Familiarity with global supply chain operations and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is an advantage

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Solid written and verbal communication skills

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

• Ability to operate effectively in high-pressure, deadline-driven environments

• Advanced user of Microsoft Office Suite

• Understanding of GMP/GDP requirements within regulated supply chains

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK584.000,00---876.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Do you want to keep projects on track through effective coordination and high-quality documentation? Can you combine attention to detail with an overview of tasks, processes and deadlines? And do you have experience supporting project managers? Then join COWI as our new Project Coordinator!

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

We are looking for a Project Coordinator to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects. You will help ensure that work follows the applicable project model and act as a sparring partner to project managers and provide coordination, administrative support and document management across assignments.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Take responsibility for project documentation, including preparing documents, reviewing and revising documentation, and ensuring it is archived in accordance with agreed rules.

• Maintain project registers to support progress and results, and share lessons learned about document management across the organisation.

• Act as a sparring partner to the project manager, assist with financial follow-up, and on your own coordinate, carry out and complete ad hoc tasks to relieve the project manager

• Plan, facilitate and report on workshops, and organise meetings, prepare agendas and write minutes.

• Develop process diagrams and guidance for project participants, and create, design and administer project workspaces.

• Train and support users of project-related tools and prepare status reports and project website content.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarter in Lyngby.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and bring a proactive and positive approach to your work. As the project’s administrative anchor, you are approachable, service-minded and flexible, while standing firm on quality requirements for processes and deliverables. You work in a structured way, maintaining an overview without losing sight of the details. You are curious about new tasks and also comfortable with routine work forming a substantial part of your day.

On top of that, you will have:

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• Experience with document management and an understanding of its importance to project quality and handover.

• Experience from a similar role in project coordination or project administration.

• An aptitude for IT, the ability to work across administrative systems, a good understanding of Microsoft Office and familiarity with SAP

• The ability to organise and see tasks through from start to finish, working with both internal colleagues and external partners.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.
